nodes.name: Census QSM norm flow
nodes.definition: The single-module rank-four Gaussian submodule QSM with endomorphism-semigroup isometries, index Hamiltonian, and classical Solomon-zeta partition function; it constructs bridge 1 only.

nodes.name: Connes-Marcolli GLn arithmetic QSM
nodes.definition: The classical higher-rank arithmetic quantum statistical system built from commensurability classes, determinant-norm time evolution, and KMS states.
sources: Connes-Marcolli, Noncommutative Geometry, Quantum Fields and Motives

nodes.name: Index-flow time evolution
nodes.definition: The dynamics sigma_t(mu_A)=Norm(det A)^(it)mu_A generated by the logarithm of submodule index on the canonical submodule Hilbert space.
